```{r , fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
res_5 <- res.base %>%

  group_by(type) %>%
  summarise(
    n_triads    = n_distinct(triads),
    n_loci      = n_distinct(locus_id),
    n_mediators = n_distinct(phenotype_A),
    n_targets   = n_distinct(phenotype_B),
    .groups     = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(significance = "5% FDR")
res_1 <- res.base %>%
  filter(fdr_sig_1 == TRUE) %>%         # only 1% hits
  group_by(type) %>%

    n_triads    = n_distinct(triads),
    n_loci      = n_distinct(locus_id),
    n_mediators = n_distinct(phenotype_A),
    n_targets   = n_distinct(phenotype_B),
    .groups     = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(significance = "1% FDR")
plot_df <- bind_rows(res_5, res_1) %>%

    pct_sig_loc = n_loci / n_loci_tested,

## 2) Common axis settings ---------------------------------------------

x_limits  <- c(0.9, 10)
x_breaks  <- seq(0, 10, by = 5)


## 3) Helper to make histograms consistent -----------------------------
make_hist <- function(
    df,
    xvar,
    title,
    xlab,
    ylab,
    x_limits  = NULL,
    x_breaks  = NULL,
    fill      = "#716f9e",
    binwidth  = 1,
    line_col  = "#3f3f3f",
    y_limits  = c(0, 110),
    y_breaks  = seq(0, 110, by = 25),
    range_var = NULL   # name of column to show range for (character or NULL)
) {
  # Base plot
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[xvar]])) +
    geom_histogram(
      binwidth  = binwidth,
      fill      = fill,
      colour    = line_col,
      linewidth = 0.2,
      boundary  = 0
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = x_limits,
      breaks = x_breaks,
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = y_limits,
      breaks = y_breaks,
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x     = xlab,
      y     = ylab
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      axis.text  = element_text(size = 16)
    )
  
  # Optional range annotation
  if (!is.null(range_var)) {
    rng <- range(df[[range_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
    label_txt <- paste0("Range: [", round(rng[1], 2), " – ", round(rng[2], 2), "]")
    
    # Use current limits (after scale_y) to place text in top-right
    y_max <- y_limits[2]
    x_max <- if (!is.null(x_limits)) x_limits[2] else max(df[[xvar]], na.rm = TRUE)
    
    p <- p +
      annotate(
        "text",
        x = x_max,
        y = y_max,
        label = label_txt,
        hjust = 1.05,
        vjust = 1.2,
        size  = 4
      )
  }
  
  p
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Annotate peaks + genes, derive relative position features,
# and run enrichment tests (rel_pos, caqtl_category, ChromBPNet)
# Minimal changes; mostly re-ordered + de-duplicated libraries.
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(readr)
  library(data.table)
  library(purrr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)
  library(sandwich)  # vcovCL
  library(lmtest)    # coeftest
  library(rtracklayer)
  library(GenomicFeatures)
  library(txdbmaker)
})

options(bitmapType = "cairo")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Inputs assumed to exist
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# - findr_res_sig : Findr results (must contain: type, phenotype_A, phenotype_B, locus_id, caqtl_category, ...)
setwd(paths_figure3$work_dir)

findr_res<-fread(paths_figure3$all_res_not_filtered_tsv)
findr_res_sig<-findr_res %>% filter(fdr_sig_5==TRUE)

## add information about the type of caQTL category
findr_res_sig <- findr_res_sig %>%
  mutate(
    caqtl_finemapped_cs = vapply(
      strsplit(finemapped_cs_coloc, "_"),
      function(x) paste(x[1:7], collapse = "_"),
      character(1)
    )
  )

caqttls<-read_csv(paths_figure3$combined_finemapping_annotated) %>% dplyr::select(finemapped_cs, cs_type_any_var)
caqttls<-caqttls[caqttls$finemapped_cs %in% findr_res_sig$caqtl_finemapped_cs, ] %>% distinct() %>%
  mutate(caqtl_category=ifelse(cs_type_any_var=="in_corr_Peak", "in_other_Peak", cs_type_any_var))

findr_res_sig<-findr_res_sig %>% left_join(caqttls, join_by("caqtl_finemapped_cs"=="finemapped_cs"))


# ============================================================
# 1) Add peak coordinates to findr_res_sig
# ============================================================

peak_coords <- read_tsv(
  paths_figure3$peak_coords_bed,
  col_names = NULL,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

peaks_names <- read.delim2(
  paths_figure3$processed_peaks_bed
)$peak_name

peak_coords <- peak_coords[peak_coords$X4 %in% peaks_names, ]
colnames(peak_coords) <- c(
  "peak_chr", "peak_start", "peak_end", "peak_name",
  "X5", "X6", "X7", "X8", "X9", "X10", "X11"
)

peaks_forward <- findr_res_sig$phenotype_A[findr_res_sig$type == "forward"]
peaks_rev     <- findr_res_sig$phenotype_B[findr_res_sig$type == "reverse"]
all_peaks     <- union(peaks_forward, peaks_rev)

peak_coords <- peak_coords[peak_coords$peak_name %in% all_peaks, ]

# unified peak identifier in findr_res_sig
findr_res_sig <- findr_res_sig %>%
  mutate(
    peak_id = if_else(
      type == "forward",
      phenotype_A,   # chromatin peak in forward model
      phenotype_B    # chromatin peak in reverse model
    )
  )

# join peak coordinates back into findr_res_sig
peak_coords_min <- peak_coords %>%
  dplyr::select(peak_name, peak_chr, peak_start, peak_end)

findr_res_sig <- findr_res_sig %>%
  left_join(peak_coords_min, by = c("peak_id" = "peak_name"))

# ============================================================
# 2) Add gene coordinates to findr_res_sig (Gencode v44 GTF)
# ============================================================

gtf_path <- paths_figure3$gtf_path

gtf  <- import(gtf_path)
txdb <- txdbmaker::makeTxDbFromGFF(gtf_path)

gene_annot <- gtf[gtf$type == "gene"]

gene_map <- as_tibble(mcols(gene_annot)) %>%
  transmute(
    gene_id_full = gene_id,
    gene_id      = sub("\\..*$", "", gene_id),
    gene_name    = gene_name
  ) %>%
  distinct()

gene_gr <- genes(txdb)

gene_coords <- as_tibble(gene_gr) %>%
  transmute(
    gene_id     = sub("\\..*$", "", gene_id),
    gene_chr    = as.character(seqnames),
    gene_start  = start,
    gene_end    = end,
    gene_strand = as.character(strand),
    gene_tss    = if_else(gene_strand == "+", gene_start, gene_end)
  )

gene_table <- gene_map %>%
  inner_join(gene_coords, by = "gene_id")

# unified gene identifier in findr_res_sig
findr_res_sig <- findr_res_sig %>%
  mutate(
    gene_symbol = if_else(
      type == "forward",
      phenotype_B,
      phenotype_A
    )
  )

gene_table <- gene_table[gene_table$gene_name %in% findr_res_sig$gene_symbol, ]

# collapse multiple transcripts per gene_name+chr
genes_collapsed <- gene_table %>%
  group_by(gene_name, gene_chr) %>%
  summarise(
    gene_start = min(gene_start, na.rm = TRUE),
    gene_end   = max(gene_end,   na.rm = TRUE),
    .idx       = which.min(replace(gene_start, is.na(gene_start), Inf)),
    gene_strand = gene_strand[.idx],
    gene_tss    = gene_tss[.idx],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-.idx)

findr_res_sig <- findr_res_sig %>%
  left_join(
    genes_collapsed,
    by = c(
      "gene_symbol" = "gene_name",
      "peak_chr"    = "gene_chr"
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# 3) Relative peak position features + locus model + triad ID
# ============================================================

findr_res_sig <- findr_res_sig %>%
  mutate(
    peak_mid = (peak_start + peak_end) / 2,
    signed_dist_TSS = case_when(
      is.na(gene_tss)    ~ NA_real_,
      gene_strand == "+" ~ as.numeric(peak_mid - gene_tss),
      gene_strand == "-" ~ as.numeric(gene_tss - peak_mid),
      TRUE               ~ NA_real_
    ),
    abs_dist_TSS = abs(signed_dist_TSS),
    
    peak_in_gene_body =
      !is.na(gene_start) & !is.na(gene_end) &
      peak_mid >= gene_start &
      peak_mid <= gene_end,
    
    peak_in_promoter =
      !is.na(gene_tss) &
      peak_mid >= (gene_tss - 2000L) &
      peak_mid <= (gene_tss + 2000L),
    
    rel_pos = case_when(
      peak_in_promoter    ~ "promoter",
      peak_in_gene_body   ~ "intragenic",
      signed_dist_TSS < 0 ~ "upstream",
      signed_dist_TSS > 0 ~ "downstream",
      TRUE                ~ "unknown"
    )
  )

# triad string (consistent forward/reverse orientation)
findr_res_sig <- findr_res_sig %>%
  mutate(
    triad = ifelse(
      type == "forward",
      paste0(locus_id, "_", phenotype_A, "_", phenotype_B),
      paste0(locus_id, "_", phenotype_B, "_", phenotype_A)
    )
  )

# locus_model (based on counts of forward vs reverse)
locus_models <- findr_res_sig %>%
  count(locus_id, type) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(
    locus_model = case_when(
      forward > reverse ~ "var->chr->gene",
      reverse > forward ~ "var->gene->chr",
      TRUE              ~ "ambiguous"
    )
  )

findr_res_sig <- findr_res_sig %>%
  left_join(locus_models, by = "locus_id")

# ============================================================
# 4) Simple promoter Fisher test (forward vs reverse)
# ============================================================

tab_prom <- findr_res_sig %>%
  distinct(triad, type, peak_in_promoter) %>%
  count(type, peak_in_promoter) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = peak_in_promoter, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)

prom_mat <- as.matrix(tab_prom[, -1])
rownames(prom_mat) <- tab_prom$type
prom_mat <- prom_mat[, c("TRUE", "FALSE")]

print(fisher.test(prom_mat))

# ============================================================
# 5) Relative position enrichment (GLM with cluster SE by locus)
# ============================================================

rel_levels <- c("downstream", "intragenic", "promoter", "upstream")

relpos_enrich <- map_dfr(rel_levels, function(pos) {
  
  df_pos <- findr_res_sig %>%
    filter(rel_pos != "unknown") %>%
    mutate(is_pos = rel_pos == pos) %>%
    distinct(triad, locus_id, locus_model, is_pos) %>%
    filter(locus_model %in% c("var->chr->gene", "var->gene->chr")) %>%
    mutate(
      locus_model = factor(locus_model),
      locus_model = relevel(locus_model, ref = "var->gene->chr"),
      is_pos_num  = as.numeric(is_pos)
    )
  
  if (n_distinct(df_pos$locus_model) < 2) {
    return(tibble(
      rel_pos    = pos,
      odds_ratio = NA_real_,
      conf_low   = NA_real_,
      conf_high  = NA_real_,
      p_value    = NA_real_
    ))
  }
  
  fit <- glm(is_pos_num ~ locus_model, data = df_pos, family = binomial())
  
  vcov_locus <- vcovCL(fit, cluster = ~ locus_id)
  ct <- coeftest(fit, vcov = vcov_locus)
  
  beta <- ct["locus_modelvar->chr->gene", "Estimate"]
  se   <- ct["locus_modelvar->chr->gene", "Std. Error"]
  p    <- ct["locus_modelvar->chr->gene", "Pr(>|z|)"]
  
  OR <- exp(beta)
  CI <- exp(beta + c(-1, 1) * 1.96 * se)
  
  tibble(
    rel_pos    = pos,
    odds_ratio = OR,
    conf_low   = CI[1],
    conf_high  = CI[2],
    p_value    = p
  )
}) %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  mutate(
    sig = case_when(
      p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE          ~ ""
    ),
    or_ci_lab = ifelse(
      is.na(odds_ratio),
      NA_character_,
      sprintf("OR=%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)%s", odds_ratio, conf_low, conf_high, sig)
    )
  )

gg_relpos <- ggplot(relpos_enrich, aes(x = rel_pos, y = odds_ratio)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = conf_low, ymax = conf_high),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.4),

# ============================================================
# 6) Category enrichment function (GLM with cluster SE by locus)
# ============================================================

run_enrich_by_category <- function(df,
                                   category_col,
                                   levels = NULL,
                                   unknown_values = c("unknown", NA),
                                   model_keep = c("var->chr->gene", "var->gene->chr")) {
  
  if (is.null(levels)) {
    levels <- df %>%
      pull(.data[[category_col]]) %>%
      unique() %>%
      sort() %>%
      as.character()
  }
  
  df0 <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[category_col]])) %>%
    filter(!(.data[[category_col]] %in% setdiff(unknown_values, NA))) %>%
    filter(locus_model %in% model_keep)
  
  map_dfr(levels, function(cat) {
    
    df_cat <- df0 %>%
      mutate(is_cat = .data[[category_col]] == cat) %>%
      distinct(triad, locus_id, locus_model, is_cat) %>%
      mutate(
        locus_model = factor(locus_model),
        locus_model = relevel(locus_model, ref = "var->gene->chr"),
        is_cat_num  = as.numeric(is_cat)
      )
    
    if (n_distinct(df_cat$locus_model) < 2) {
      return(tibble(
        category   = cat,
        odds_ratio = NA_real_,
        conf_low   = NA_real_,
        conf_high  = NA_real_,
        p_value    = NA_real_
      ))
    }
    
    fit <- glm(is_cat_num ~ locus_model, data = df_cat, family = binomial())
    
    vc <- vcovCL(fit, cluster = ~ locus_id)
    ct <- coeftest(fit, vcov. = vc)
    
    term <- "locus_modelvar->chr->gene"
    beta <- ct[term, "Estimate"]
    se   <- ct[term, "Std. Error"]
    p    <- ct[term, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    
    OR <- exp(beta)
    CI <- exp(beta + c(-1, 1) * 1.96 * se)
    
    tibble(
      category   = cat,
      odds_ratio = OR,
      conf_low   = CI[1],
      conf_high  = CI[2],
      p_value    = p
    )
  })
}

caqtl_enrich <- run_enrich_by_category(

    )
  )

# locus-level dataset: one row per (locus_id, type)
locus_df <- findr_res_sig %>%
  filter(!is.na(peak_id), nzchar(peak_id)) %>%
  mutate(
    type = factor(type, levels = c("reverse", "forward")),
    has_cpnet    = peak_id %in% cpbnet_peaks,
    has_cpnet_tf = peak_id %in% cpbnet_peaks_TF
  ) %>%
  group_by(locus_id, type) %>%
  summarise(
    any_cpnet    = any(has_cpnet),
    any_cpnet_tf = any(has_cpnet_tf),
    n_triads     = n(),
    n_peaks      = n_distinct(peak_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

fit_any <- glm(any_cpnet ~ type, data = locus_df, family = binomial())
fit_tf  <- glm(any_cpnet_tf ~ type, data = locus_df, family = binomial())

tidy_or <- function(fit, label) {
  broom::tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) %>%
    filter(term == "typeforward") %>%
    transmute(
      feature    = label,
      odds_ratio = estimate,
      conf_low   = conf.low,
      conf_high  = conf.high,
      p_value    = p.value
    )
}

glm_locus_enrich <- bind_rows(
  tidy_or(fit_any, "ChromBPNet var (any)"),

    p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    sig = case_when(
      p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE          ~ ""
    ),
    or_ci_lab = sprintf("OR=%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)%s", odds_ratio, conf_low, conf_high, sig)
  )
```

```{r , locus-plot,  fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 0) PATHS (edit here once)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
make_causality_plot_paths <- function() {
  paths_figure3
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) LOAD RESOURCES ONCE: causality_bed, bed_df, metadata
# ------------------------------------------------------------
load_causality_plot_resources <- function(paths) {
  all_res <- read_tsv(paths$all_res_tsv, show_col_types = FALSE)
  
  # peak coordinates (subset to filtered peak names)
  peak_names <- read_tsv(paths$filtered_peaks, col_names = FALSE, show_col_types = FALSE)
  bed_df <- read_tsv(paths$peaks_bed, col_select = 1:4, col_names = FALSE, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    filter(X4 %in% peak_names$X1)
  colnames(bed_df) <- c("peak_chr", "peak_start", "peak_end", "peak_name")
  
  # build causality_bed safely (chr/pos parsed from exposure_variable)
  causality_bed <- all_res %>%
    mutate(
      chr_raw = str_match(exposure_variable, "^([0-9XYMT]+):")[,2],
      pos     = as.integer(str_match(exposure_variable, "^[0-9XYMT]+:([0-9]+)\\[")[,2]),
      chr     = paste0("chr", chr_raw),
      gene_chr = peak_chr
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      chr, pos, exposure_variable, phenotype_A, phenotype_B,
      peak_chr, peak_start, peak_end, gene_chr, gene_tss, gene_strand, type
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      chr      = sub("^chrchr", "chr", chr),
      peak_chr = sub("^chrchr", "chr", peak_chr),
      gene_chr = sub("^chrchr", "chr", gene_chr),
      type     = tolower(type)
    )
  
  metadata <- read.csv(paths$metadata_csv, sep = ",", row.names = 1)
  
  list(
    all_res = all_res,
    bed_df = bed_df,
    causality_bed = causality_bed,
    metadata = metadata
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) SMALL HELPERS
# ------------------------------------------------------------
parse_instrument_chrpos <- function(instrument) {
  m <- regexec("^([0-9XYMT]+):([0-9]+)\\[b[0-9]+\\]", instrument)
  x <- regmatches(instrument, m)[[1]]
  if (length(x) < 3) stop("Could not parse instrument: ", instrument)
  list(chr_raw = x[2], chr = paste0("chr", x[2]), pos = as.integer(x[3]))
}

strip_region_prefix <- function(region_x, chr_raw) {
  # handles: "21:START-END"  OR already "START-END"
  out <- sub(paste0("^", chr_raw, ":"), "", region_x)
  out
}

# for each causality_bed row, infer gene/peak depending on direction
infer_gene_peak_from_row <- function(type, phenotype_A, phenotype_B) {
  type <- tolower(type)
  if (!type %in% c("forward","reverse")) return(list(gene = NA_character_, peak = NA_character_))
  if (type == "forward") {
    list(gene = phenotype_B, peak = phenotype_A)
  } else {
    list(gene = phenotype_A, peak = phenotype_B)
  }
}

compute_zoom_from_row <- function(pos, gene_tss, peak_start, peak_end,
                                  pad_frac = 0.25, pad_min = 1000L, pad_max = NULL) {
  vals <- c(pos, gene_tss, peak_start, peak_end)
  vals <- vals[is.finite(vals)]
  if (!length(vals)) stop("No finite coordinates to compute zoom window.")
  
  left <- min(vals); right <- max(vals)
  span <- max(1L, right - left)
  
  pad <- max(as.integer(span * pad_frac), as.integer(pad_min))
  if (!is.null(pad_max)) pad <- min(pad, as.integer(pad_max))
  
  list(
    start = max(1L, as.integer(left - pad)),
    end   = as.integer(right + pad),
    span  = span,
    pad   = pad
  )
}

build_gene_track_gencode <- function(region_zoom,
                                     transcripts = NULL,
                                    gencode_dir = paths_figure3$references_dir,
                                     release = "44") {
  # region_zoom can be "chrX:START-END" or a GRanges
  region_gr <- if (inherits(region_zoom, "GRanges")) region_zoom else str_to_gr(region_zoom)
  
  # load/cached transcripts if not provided
  if (is.null(transcripts)) {
    transcripts <- read_gencode_genes(gencode_dir, release = release)
  }
  
  trackplot_gene_custom(transcripts, region_gr) + ggplot2::guides(color = "none")
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) MAIN: give it ONE coloc row (triplicate) -> makes the whole plot
# ------------------------------------------------------------
plot_from_coloc_triplet <- function(coloc_triplet_row,
                                    resources,
                                    paths,
                                    direction = c("forward", "reverse", "auto"),
                                    zoom_pad_frac = 0.25,
                                    zoom_pad_min  = 1000L,
                                    zoom_pad_max  = NULL,
                                    region_window_broad = 300000L,
                                    out_pdf = NULL,
                                    width = 7,
                                    height = 5) {
  
  direction <- match.arg(direction)
  
  row <- as.list(coloc_triplet_row)
  req_cols <- c("gene", "peak", "caQTL_variant", "eQTL_variant", "region.x")
  missing <- setdiff(req_cols, names(row))
  if (length(missing)) stop("coloc_triplet_row missing columns: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  
  gene_name <- as.character(row$gene)
  peak_name <- as.character(row$peak)
  ca_var    <- as.character(row$caQTL_variant)
  eq_var    <- as.character(row$eQTL_variant)
  region_x  <- as.character(row$region.x)
  
  # -------- choose instrument, but FALL BACK if not present in causality_bed --------
  in_bed <- function(v) any(resources$causality_bed$exposure_variable == v)
  
  if (direction == "forward") {
    instrument <- ca_var
    if (!in_bed(instrument) && in_bed(eq_var)) instrument <- eq_var
    if (!in_bed(instrument)) stop("Neither caQTL_variant nor eQTL_variant found in causality_bed for this triplet.")
  } else if (direction == "reverse") {
    instrument <- eq_var
    if (!in_bed(instrument) && in_bed(ca_var)) instrument <- ca_var
    if (!in_bed(instrument)) stop("Neither eQTL_variant nor caQTL_variant found in causality_bed for this triplet.")
  } else {
    # auto
    instrument <- if (in_bed(ca_var)) ca_var else eq_var
    if (!in_bed(instrument)) stop("Neither caQTL_variant nor eQTL_variant found in causality_bed for this triplet.")
  }
  
  ip <- parse_instrument_chrpos(instrument)
  chr_raw <- ip$chr_raw
  chr     <- ip$chr
  pos     <- ip$pos
  
  # -------- match causality_bed rows for instrument then compute gene/peak per row (vectorized) --------
  df_inst0 <- resources$causality_bed %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$exposure_variable == instrument)
  
  if (nrow(df_inst0) == 0) {
    stop("No rows in causality_bed for instrument = ", instrument,
         ". (Try direction='auto' or verify this variant exists in your mediation results.)")
  }
  
  df_inst <- df_inst0 %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      type = tolower(.data$type),
      gene_tmp = dplyr::case_when(
        .data$type == "forward" ~ .data$phenotype_B,
        .data$type == "reverse" ~ .data$phenotype_A,
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      peak_tmp = dplyr::case_when(
        .data$type == "forward" ~ .data$phenotype_A,
        .data$type == "reverse" ~ .data$phenotype_B,
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$gene_tmp == gene_name, .data$peak_tmp == peak_name)
  
  if (nrow(df_inst) == 0) {
    stop("Instrument found in causality_bed, but no row matches gene+peak for this coloc triplet.\n",
         "instrument=", instrument, "\n",
         "gene=", gene_name, "\n",
         "peak=", peak_name)
  }
  
  # If user forced direction forward/reverse, enforce matching type as well
  if (direction %in% c("forward","reverse")) {
    df_inst <- df_inst %>% dplyr::filter(.data$type == direction)
    if (nrow(df_inst) == 0) stop("Matched gene+peak, but no row matches requested direction=", direction)
  }
  
  caus_row <- df_inst[1, , drop = FALSE]
  type <- caus_row$type[[1]]
  
  # -------- zoom from causality_bed geometry --------
  zoom <- compute_zoom_from_row(
    pos        = pos,
    gene_tss   = as.integer(caus_row$gene_tss[[1]]),
    peak_start = as.integer(caus_row$peak_start[[1]]),
    peak_end   = as.integer(caus_row$peak_end[[1]]),
    pad_frac   = zoom_pad_frac,
    pad_min    = zoom_pad_min,
    pad_max    = zoom_pad_max
  )
  start_pos <- zoom$start
  end_pos   <- zoom$end
  
  minStart <- max(1L, pos - as.integer(region_window_broad))
  maxEnd   <- pos + as.integer(region_window_broad)
  
  region_zoom   <- paste0(chr, ":", start_pos, "-", end_pos)
  region_nochr  <- strip_region_prefix(region_x, chr_raw)
  title_txt     <- paste0(instrument, " (", type, "): ", str_to_pretty(region_zoom))
  
  # -------- caQTL scatter --------
  prep_ca    <- prepare_caqtl_data(chr, peak_name, region_nochr, ca_var)
  markers_ca <- prep_ca$markers
  LD_ca      <- prep_ca$LD
  
  markers_ca <- markers_ca %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      pos_hg38 = as.integer(stringr::str_extract(marker, "(?<=:)\\d+")),
      z_pos0   = z_caqtl
    ) %>%
    add_ld_from_lead(LD_ca, lead_pos = pos)
  
  p.caqtl <- plot_qtl_scatter(
    markers_df = markers_ca,
    minStart   = minStart,
    maxEnd     = maxEnd,
    region     = region_zoom,
    label_txt  = paste0("caQTL ", ca_var, " ", peak_name)
  )
  
  # -------- eQTL scatter --------
  prep_eq      <- prepare_eqtl_data(chr, gene_name, region_nochr, eq_var)
  markers_eqtl <- prep_eq$markers
  LD_eqtl      <- prep_eq$LD
  
  markers_eqtl <- markers_eqtl %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      pos_hg38 = as.integer(stringr::str_extract(marker, "(?<=:)\\d+")),
      z_pos0   = z_eqtl
    ) %>%
    add_ld_from_lead(LD_eqtl, lead_pos = pos)
  
  p.eqtl <- plot_qtl_scatter(
    markers_df = markers_eqtl,
    minStart   = minStart,
    maxEnd     = maxEnd,
    region     = region_zoom,
    label_txt  = paste0("eQTL ", eq_var, " ", gene_name)
  )
  
  # -------- coverage --------
  track_data <- prepareTrackData_grouped_genotype(
    variant_id = instrument,
    metadata   = resources$metadata,
    base_dir   = paths$base_dir,
    bigwig_dir = paths$bigwig_dir
  )
  gene_range_zoom <- GenomicRanges::GRanges(chr, IRanges::IRanges(start_pos, end_pos))
  p.peaks_zoom <- plotGroupedCoverage_allelic_fill(track_data, gene_range_zoom)
  
  # -------- peak delimiters --------
  hits_gr <- GenomicRanges::GRanges(
    seqnames = resources$bed_df$peak_chr,
    ranges   = IRanges::IRanges(start = resources$bed_df$peak_start, end = resources$bed_df$peak_end),
    name     = resources$bed_df$peak_name
  )
  p.peak_delim <- trackplot_peak_delim(hits_gr, region_zoom, color = "cyan4")
  
  # -------- links (Hi-C style) --------
  p.links <- plot_region_links_hic(
    resources$causality_bed,
    instruments     = instrument,
    chr             = chr,
    x_start         = start_pos,
    x_end           = end_pos,
    draw_peaks_on_A = TRUE
  )
  
  # -------- genes --------
  track_genes <- build_gene_track_gencode(
    region_zoom  = region_zoom,
    transcripts  = resources$transcripts  # cached
  )
  
  # -------- combine --------
  track_plot <- trackplot_combine2(
    list(
      BPCells:::wrap_trackplot(p.caqtl,      grid::unit(0.10, "null")) + indiv_theme,
      BPCells:::wrap_trackplot(p.eqtl,       grid::unit(0.10, "null")) + indiv_theme,
      BPCells:::wrap_trackplot(p.peaks_zoom, grid::unit(0.15, "null")) + indiv_theme,
      BPCells:::wrap_trackplot(p.peak_delim, grid::unit(0.05, "null")) + indiv_theme,
      BPCells:::wrap_trackplot(p.links,      grid::unit(0.05, "null")) + indiv_theme,
      BPCells:::wrap_trackplot(track_genes,  grid::unit(0.05, "null")) + indiv_theme
    ),
    title = title_txt
  )
  
  if (!is.null(out_pdf)) {
    ggplot2::ggsave(out_pdf, track_plot, width = width, height = height)
  }
  
  list(
    plot = track_plot,
    meta = list(
      instrument = instrument,
      type = type,
      chr = chr,
      pos = pos,
      gene = gene_name,
      peak = peak_name,
      region_zoom = region_zoom,
      region_nochr = region_nochr,
      zoom = zoom
    )
  )
}
```
